title: Badmaash Company
description: Set in the 1990s, Badmaash Company tells the story of four ambitious middle-class friends who, tired of conventional paths, decide to start an import-export business. They soon discover and exploit loopholes in the system to achieve quick and immense wealth. The film follows their journey of friendship, ambition, and the moral compromises they make as their success grows.

title: Coolie
description: A Muslim coolie (porter) working at a railway station rises to become a champion for the working class, fighting against exploitation and social injustices. He unknowingly crosses paths with his long-lost mother and confronts a wealthy businessman tied to a tragic secret from his past.

title: Half CA - Season 1
description: Half CA - Season 1 follows Archi, an aspiring Chartered Accountant from Indore, as she navigates the demanding and competitive world of CA examinations. The series delves into the intense academic pressure, personal sacrifices, and societal expectations faced by students pursuing this rigorous professional course. It explores her journey alongside friends and family, highlighting the challenges and emotional toll of their aspirations.

title: Housefull 5A
description: This installment of the popular Housefull series is anticipated to deliver another dose of high-energy, chaotic comedy. It would likely feature a large ensemble cast entangled in a web of mistaken identities, farcical situations, and hilarious misunderstandings. The story aims to provide light-hearted entertainment through its signature blend of slapstick humor and convoluted plotlines, characteristic of the franchise.

title: Jamnapaar - Season 2
description: Jamnapaar - Season 2 continues the story of Shantanu, a young man from East Delhi, as he further navigates the complex social dynamics and expectations of his two worlds. The season delves deeper into his struggles with identity, ambition, and the constant pressure to reconcile his humble roots with his aspirations for a successful modern life in West Delhi. He grapples with societal perceptions and the journey of self-acceptance while chasing his dreams.

title: Maalik
description: A retired Special Service Group officer, now a peaceful village elder, is forced to take a stand against a corrupt political establishment threatening his people. The film explores themes of justice, patriotism, and the struggle against powerful elites who exploit the nation for personal gain.

title: Mirzapur - Season 1
description: Set in the lawless city of Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh, India, the series chronicles the reign of Akhandanand Tripathi, also known as Kaleen Bhaiya, a ruthless don who controls the city's illicit arms and carpet businesses. The story follows the Pandit brothers, Guddu and Bablu, whose lives become entangled with Kaleen Bhaiya's empire after an incident, drawing them into a dangerous world of power, violence, and ambition.

title: Mirzapur - Season 2
description: Mirzapur - Season 2 picks up after the shocking and violent events of the first season, with the surviving characters grappling with loss and a burning desire for revenge. The power vacuum created leads to new alliances and rivalries, as various factions and individuals vie for control over the crime-ridden city. The season explores deeper into the political landscape, family loyalties, and the ruthless pursuit of dominance.

title: Rise And Fall - Season 1
description: Sixteen ordinary people are divided into 'Rulers' who live in luxury and 'Grafters' who toil in the basement of an extravagant apartment block. They must work together to build a cash prize, but only one contestant can ultimately rise to power and claim the entire fortune. The series explores power dynamics and social hierarchy in a competitive format.
